parsed.explanation: The combined regime is driven by national measures that reach visitors. Entry screening lets officers refuse applicants on any document or sex-doubt discrepancy, with a possible lifetime fraud ineligibility finding. Documented immigration-custody harm includes forced labour, beatings and sexual abuse of trans men. Federal hostility includes hospital record subpoenas and counterterrorism framing. The state adds no statewide adult facility ban, no adult care ban, no sodomy law and recognised marriage, but it has no statewide gender-identity nondiscrimination or hate-crime coverage outside four municipalities. Youth-care restrictions are a draft, not operative. Net: elevated-to-high exposure, anchored by custody harm and universal entry risk.

entry_documents.exposure: Passports cannot change sex marker; new applications processed M/F only. Cable instructs refusal of case on any document discrepancy or sex doubt, plus possible lifetime fraud ineligibility. Passports confiscated or blocked for some trans travellers.
entry_documents.protection: Limited waiver possibilities; fraud finding not automatic; litigation pending on passport policy.
entry_documents.interaction: Document mismatch at entry leads to refusal and may escalate to fraud finding, then to detention or stranding abroad.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: Immigration custody: documented forced labour, beatings, solitary confinement and severe sexual abuse of trans men. National corrections adopted policies removing hormones and hair care for trans inmates; prisoner counts stopped being reported.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Civil-liberties suits pending; several orders enjoined; no documented operative custody protection.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: A visitor refused at entry or detained for presentation enters custody where documented national practice causes serious harm.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: Federal order bars gender-congruent use of government-funded single-sex facilities. State: no statewide adult restroom or changing-room ban. Four-state criminal trespass regime exists elsewhere; this state is not documented as one of them.
federal_state_facilities.protection: No statewide adult facility ban in this state; four municipalities have local ordinances.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Federal rule applies to federal buildings regardless of state position; the state's absence of a ban does not cover federal sites.

care_services.exposure: Federal subpoenas of hospital records for under-19 patients. Proposed federal rule to bar public insurance reimbursement for under-18 care. State medical board draft (unprofessional-conduct classification for care under 18) not yet operative.
care_services.protection: Draft requires law department vetting and a 30-day comment period; adult care not restricted.
care_services.interaction: Care access for adults is not restricted by statute; youth care is exposed through federal and pending state measures.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: Federal counterterrorism memo and strategy frame 'radically pro-transgender' groups as targets for neutralisation. Executive order directs criminal investigation of schools using preferred names or pronouns for trans minors.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: Strategy states powers will not target people who merely disagree; enjoined orders noted.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Official threat-framing at national level can reach visitors through police or security contact.

minors_guardians.exposure: Travelling trans minor exposed to federal facility and school-directed prosecution rules. Youth care is restricted or pending in multiple layers; one school district requires birth-sex bathrooms. Guardian exposure to records subpoenas and possible investigation.
minors_guardians.protection: District policy binds one district only; state youth-care rule not operative; minor-specific entry rules not documented.
minors_guardians.interaction: A minor needing care or school access may be investigated through the same channels that affect the guardian.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: Single bathroom-trespass arrest in another state (first known, 24 hours held); no documented trans-specific violence count or general homicide baseline for this state.
street_violence_police_response.protection: State hate-crime statute omits gender identity; four municipalities cover gender identity in public accommodations.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Outside the four municipalities a visitor has no local recourse for discrimination or hate incidents.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Nondiscrimination coverage is absent statewide. Enforcement of municipal ordinances is not documented. Advisories from allied governments were issued.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Marriage recognised statewide; no sodomy law; birth certificate and licence marker changes available with a clinical letter or court order.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Recognised marriage and state-level document routes do not reduce federal entry or custody exposure for visiting trans travellers.

anchor_checks.comparison: 0.35-A is an exclusion register with refusals for visibly trans travellers and no imprisonment. This case shares refusal risk at entry, but adds documented custody sexual abuse and forced labour, so it sits lower than 0.35-A in severity and close to it in universal entry exposure.

0.25-C documents birth-sex custody housing with frequent assaults and rare protective transfers. This case has documented sexual abuse in immigration custody, similar severity, but a less universal regime for in-state adults and some municipal recourse, so it sits slightly above 0.25-C.

0.45-D describes database registration and harassment without custody. This case adds documented custody abuse and fraud-ineligibility risk at entry, placing it below 0.45-D, while the state's marriage recognition and lack of adult facility ban keep it above the lower-band anchors.

parsed.synthesis: A visitor's main exposure is the national regime. Entry refusals on document discrepancy, with a possible lifetime fraud finding, are universal for trans travellers. If detained, documented custody practice includes sexual abuse and forced labour. The state offers fewer restrictions for adults, with no statewide facility ban, no adult care ban, marriage recognition and no sodomy law. Those features do not offset federal entry and custody exposure, and the absence of statewide hate-crime and nondiscrimination coverage removes local recourse outside four municipalities. Youth-related measures are pending or limited to one district, so a minor's exposure runs mainly through federal channels affecting the guardian.
